svg.title: From fault to a safe state — measured
svg.desc: Live testnet pair, November 2026. Times are seconds after each fault in separate development and release-candidate runs. Network isolation with the shipped six-round default: holder stepped down at 36 seconds. A hung holder paged at 8 seconds, hard stop at 47 seconds, confirmed down at 64 seconds. A killed validator restarted on its own unstaked identity within 3 seconds. Separate spare runs with a 60-second configured delay paged at 65 to 72 seconds by default, or took cold at 66 to 71 seconds when armed. The 60-second delay anchors to observed delinquency. The axis anchors to the induced fault. These are measured outcomes, not bounds.
